title: The Boiling Iron Rig — Elemental Prison Break
core_loop_30s: Extract compressed coal/iron from industrial vents (CoalVent_01) -> Form Metal Shield to block Warden pyro-volleys -> Launch Earth Lance counter-attacks during Warden overheat window.
early_hook_90s: Infiltrate by skiff at PlayerBoatSpawn, breach the courtyard barricades using environmental metal sources, and trigger the Warden boss encounter.

steps.objective: Land at PlayerBoatSpawn and inspect the Iron Rig deck
Draw ore from Interactables/CoalVent_01 using MetalBending
Enter BossArena/ArenaTrigger and defeat Boss Warden
